info.name: Ekō Deep Regression - Edge Cases and Failure Modes
info.description: Deep local regression suite for Ekō. This collection uses Postman test scripts to run large request matrices against the running local API. It checks detector bypass attempts, false-positive guards, token/session behavior, SLM contextual detection, proxy headers, SSE violation events, and metrics. Start with `docker compose --profile slm up --build -d` and keep `proxy.slm.timeout_ms` high enough for CPU inference, e.g. 2500ms.
